title: 10.2 Hour Distribution
prompt: 10.2 Write a program that prompts for a file name (the autograder will provide mbox-short.txt), reads the file, and figures out the distribution by hour of the day for each of the messages. Pull the hour from the 'From ' line, count by hour, and print counts sorted by hour.
learning_objective: Count messages by hour of day and print the distribution sorted by hour.
hint: From each From line, take the time field, split on ':', count by hour, then print sorted(hour, count).
solution_explanation: The time token on a From line splits into hour:minute:second. Count by hour in a dictionary, then print the hours in sorted order with their counts.

student.py.starter:
name = input("Enter file:")
if len(name) < 1:
    name = "mbox-short.txt"
handle = open(name)
student.py.solution:
name = input("Enter file:")
if len(name) < 1 : name = "mbox-short.txt"
handle = open(name)
counts = dict()
for line in handle:
    wds = line.split()
    if len(wds) < 6 : continue
    if wds[0] != "From" : continue
    when = wds[5]
    tics = when.split(":")
    if len(tics) != 3 : continue
    hour = tics[0]
    counts[hour] = counts.get(hour,0) + 1

for key, val in sorted(counts.items()):
    print(key, val)
